basic_info.description: Brand new, 1 Bedroom 1 Bath home with valet parking and water view. We are 80% sold out! Features include Miele appliances and gorgeous marble countertops. Designed by Woods Bagot, 2177 Third is luxury living that is quintessentially San Francisco and features curated amenities like a beautifully landscaped center courtyard, private gym, rooftop terrace, pet spa, residence lounge and co-working space. All photography, renderings & views are representative of the Development.
